title: Recursive trace logic predicts embodiment is a special case

tellings.quote: And I just discovered in the last two or three weeks that it does this model does predict that embodiment is a special case that the normal case for consciousness in this framework is not to be embodied.

plain: A scientist named Don Hoffman, who studies consciousness, says that in 2026 he found that his mathematical model of consciousness, built on what he calls recursive trace logic, predicts that having a body is a special case, and that the normal state of consciousness is to exist without one. Hoffman tells this as his own recent discovery, made in the weeks before the interview. If right, it would mean most consciousness in the universe is not tied to bodies at all.
